overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for long-running campaigns and optimizing endgame tick processing. This batch ensures 100% Monte Carlo survival rate stability and reduces memory footprint for 5,500+ tick simulations without introducing cascading header dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compression for Tick History
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array<uint8_t, 1024> for fixed-size buffers. Implement a static inline function `compressTick` that packs 5,500 ticks into a bitfield using constexpr logic. No dynamic allocation. Use `std::bit_cast` for type punning. Ensure all operations are noexcept. The compressor must handle 16,500 footsteps by indexing into a static lookup table. Memory layout must be cache-line aligned (64 bytes).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Compression ratio > 85% for 5,500 ticks. 2. Zero heap allocations during compression. 3. Decompression is O(1) for random access. 4. All tests pass with 0 deadlocks.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster load times for long campaigns; smoother UI responsiveness during endgame reviews.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Survival Rate Calculation for 100% Stability
tasks.architectural_spec: Replace iterative loops with unrolled constexpr calculations for the 16,500 footsteps. Use `std::span` for view-based access to precomputed survival probabilities. Implement a static `constexpr` array for the 100% survival rate lookup. Ensure no floating-point drift by using fixed-point arithmetic (int64_t scaled by 1e6). All functions must be `noexcept` and `constexpr` where possible.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Survival rate calculation completes in < 1 microsecond. 2. Fixed-point arithmetic matches IEEE 754 within 1e-6 tolerance. 3. No deadlocks in parallel execution. 4. Memory usage < 1KB for state.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instantaneous feedback on simulation outcomes; reliable endgame statistics.

tasks.title: Cache-Line Aligned Endgame Narrative State Machine
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a `struct alignas(64) NarrativeState` containing 4 `uint32_t` fields for tick, step, event, and status. Implement a static `constexpr` transition table for 10 endgame states. Use `std::bit_cast` for state transitions. No virtual functions. All methods are `inline` and `noexcept`. The state machine must process 5,500 ticks in a single pass with no branching penalties.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. State transitions are branchless. 2. Cache miss rate < 1% for sequential access. 3. Narrative output is deterministic across runs. 4. Zero heap allocations.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Consistent and predictable story progression; no lag during endgame sequences.
